display.purpose: Page titles, nav, section labels, headlines at high importance.

body.purpose: Event descriptions and other reading content.

dateline.purpose: Place + date stamp on every event clipping — the one monospace use in the system.

motion.name: clipping-hover
motion.purpose: The signature interaction: an expandable event clipping's headline transitions to wire-red on hover/focus before the click/Enter/Space toggle reveals its full text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled wire-red action button. Foreground flips ivory/ink by theme — see the Wire-Red Foreground Rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c81e3a; color: #fbf8f1; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 1px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(200,30,58,0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1a1714, 0 0 0 4px #f6f1e4; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-btn-primary { background: #e54d61; color: #1a1714; } }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only chrome control (menu toggle, theme toggle, close). No fill at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1a1714; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 1px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #ede6d4; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1a1714, 0 0 0 4px #f6f1e4; }

components.name: Event Clipping
components.description: The signature content unit: a wire dateline, a headline sized by importance, a category swatch + label, and a serif description — separated from siblings by a hairline rule, never boxed individually.

components.css: .ds-clipping { border-bottom: 1px solid #d8d0be; padding: 0.75rem 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-clipping-dateline { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #6b6355; } .ds-clipping-title { font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: -0.005em; margin-top: 0.25rem; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-clipping:hover .ds-clipping-title { color: #c81e3a; } .ds-clipping-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #6b6355; margin-top: 0.25rem; } .ds-clipping-swatch { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; background: #dc2626; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-clipping-desc { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #6b6355; margin-top: 0.375rem; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Index-tab style nav item: a left border marks the active route, not a filled pill.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.9375rem; border-left: 2px solid transparent; font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: rgba(242,237,227,0.7); background: #141210; transition: color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #f2ede3; border-left-color: #3a362e; background: rgba(58,54,46,0.2); } .ds-nav-item--active { color: #e86475; border-left-color: #e86475; background: rgba(58,54,46,0.4); }

components.name: Map Overlay Plaque
components.description: Solid dark plaque for controls floating over the map (projection toggle, heat legend). Not theme-reactive — the basemap underneath is always light. No blur, no glass.
components.css: .ds-overlay-plaque { background: rgba(20,18,16,0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); font-family: Oswald, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; }

narrative.overview:
Century Road reads as a press archive, not a library, a museum, or a SaaS dashboard. Every historical event is a dateline — a place and a date stamped together, the way a wire bulletin's header works — and the whole interface adopts a newsroom's own working materials: bulletin-paper ivory, newsprint ink, ruled clippings instead of cards, and exactly one committed color (wire-red) reserved for the interactive and "live" moments. This direction was assigned by the project's concept-seed roll rather than picked by default — the obvious "atlas/almanac" (cream + sepia + hairline cartography) was offered and explicitly declined as the more predictable choice for a historical-cartographic product.

The system is deliberately restrained: neutrals carry the surface, one accent carries emphasis, and radius is functionally zero throughout (clippings and rules, not soft rounded cards). Nothing here is glass, blur, or gradient — depth comes from hairline rules and ruled division, never shadow.
keyCharacteristics: One committed accent (wire-red) — never a decorative field, always interactive/active/"today"
Ruled clippings, not cards — hairline dividers replace borders-plus-shadow
Type size carries importance (event headline size scales with historical importance) — not color alone
Display voice (Oswald) for headings/labels; reading voice (Source Serif 4) for event titles and body content
Near-zero radius everywhere (1–2px) — square, not soft
The sidebar is a fixed newsroom-black directory board that never themes with light/dark — everything else does

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Wire-red is the only saturated color permitted in the interface. Category color-coding stays deliberately quieter — solid small squares, never filled pill backgrounds.

rules.name: The Wire-Red Foreground Rule
rules.body: A filled wire-red surface uses ivory text in light mode but dark ink text in dark mode — dark-mode wire-red is brighter and needs dark text, not ivory-on-ivory. Caught as a real WCAG failure during the build (4.02:1, under the 4.5:1 floor) and fixed; don't revert to one foreground for both themes.

rules.name: The Sidebar Accent Rule
rules.body: Never use the primary token for text inside the sidebar. The sidebar never themes with light/dark, but primary does — light-mode wire-red on the sidebar's fixed dark background measures 2.85:1, a real failure. Use sidebar-accent (verified 4.99:1) instead.

rules.name: The Single-Weight Rule
rules.body: Both custom faces are self-hosted at exactly one weight each (600). Nothing uses a browser-synthesized faux bold.

rules.name: The Size-Carries-Importance Rule
rules.body: An event's historical importance maps to headline type size, never to color — donated by a declined challenger during the direction round.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface sits flush with no elevation. Nothing lifts on hover; only color and hairline rules communicate state.

dos: Do reserve wire-red for interactive/active/"today" moments only.
Do use sidebar-accent (never primary) for any accent color rendered inside the sidebar.
Do use dark ink (not ivory) as the foreground on a dark-mode wire-red fill.
Do let event importance drive headline type size, not a color or icon change.
Do keep both custom typefaces at their single hosted weight (600).
Do separate list content with hairline rules instead of individual card borders + shadow.
donts: Don't add backdrop-blur or any glass treatment.
Don't round corners beyond the 1–2px system radius.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent color alongside wire-red — use rust for a genuine destructive/delete need.
Don't use the light-mode wire-red value inside the sidebar or any other fixed-dark surface without verifying contrast by computation.
